model_species: Human breast cancer cells / recombinant human ER
evidence_endpoint: Direct receptor binding and ER-responsive transcriptional activity
evidence_summary: Triclosan displaced estradiol from estrogen receptors in MCF7 cells and recombinant human ERα/ERβ and altered ER-responsive transcription/growth.
audit_note: Direct receptor-level evidence; does not imply tumor exposure in patients.

model_species: Human/mouse mammary cell assays and recombinant/rat AR
evidence_endpoint: Direct AR ligand-binding / AR-responsive transcriptional modulation
evidence_summary: Triclosan displaced testosterone from the AR ligand-binding domain and altered androgen-responsive transcription; additional assays show antiandrogenic/androgen-modulating activity.
audit_note: Direct receptor-level evidence; direction depends on assay/context.

evidence_endpoint: Progesterone receptor transcript expression
evidence_summary: Placental progesterone receptor (PR/PGR) mRNA was reported as up-regulated after triclosan exposure in pregnant rats.
audit_note: Nonhuman in vivo evidence; no claim of direct ligand binding to human PGR.

evidence_endpoint: Thyroid hormone receptor alpha transcript modulation
evidence_summary: Triclosan altered thyroid-hormone-receptor alpha transcript levels in anuran models; effects were tissue/context dependent.
audit_note: Nonhuman endocrine-disruption evidence; not a human tumor target claim.

evidence_endpoint: TRβ transcript modulation
evidence_summary: Triclosan altered T3-mediated TRβ mRNA expression in tadpole tail fin and altered thyroid-hormone-receptor mRNA expression in Xenopus cells.
audit_note: Nonhuman endocrine-disruption evidence; tissue and treatment context affect direction.

evidence_endpoint: CAT gene/enzyme modulation and triclosan-catalase interaction
evidence_summary: Triclosan altered catalase-related antioxidant responses, including CAT transcript changes in zebrafish; a separate biophysical study characterized direct triclosan-catalase interaction.
audit_note: Predominantly nonhuman/biophysical evidence.

model_species: Human placental syncytiotrophoblasts / human lymphoma cells
evidence_endpoint: BCL2 protein/expression modulation
evidence_summary: Triclosan decreased anti-apoptotic BCL2 in human placental syncytiotrophoblasts and in other mammalian cell models; BJAB lymphoma cells also showed BCL2 down-regulation.
audit_note: Direct human cell evidence; direction can be context dependent across models.

model_species: Human placental syncytiotrophoblasts / human HepG2 and other mammalian models
evidence_endpoint: BAX protein/expression modulation
evidence_summary: Triclosan altered pro-apoptotic BAX in human placental cells and HepG2 cells, with direction varying by dose/model; multiple animal/cell studies support BAX involvement.
audit_note: Direct human cell evidence but direction is context dependent.

evidence_endpoint: Cleaved PARP1 protein during triclosan-induced apoptosis
evidence_summary: Triclosan exposure increased cleaved PARP1 in porcine oocyte/cumulus complexes during mitochondrial apoptosis.
audit_note: Protein cleavage/pathway evidence; not proof of PARP1 transcriptional regulation.

model_species: Human immune cells / human placental cells
evidence_endpoint: IL6 mRNA and cytokine production
evidence_summary: Triclosan increased IL6 mRNA and IL-6 production/secretion in human immune cells; placental-cell studies also report IL6 induction under triclosan exposure.
audit_note: Strong human cell evidence; inflammatory context.

evidence_endpoint: ABCB1/MDR1 mRNA expression
evidence_summary: ABCB1 was directly measured in a qPCR drug-resistance panel after triclosan treatment of human MHCC97-H cells. The study reported induction of ABC/drug-resistance genes as a group; the accessible text does not provide a separate ABCB1 effect size.
audit_note: Direct human cancer-cell measurement; supports inclusion in a triclosan-responsive drug-resistance panel but avoids overclaiming a gene-specific magnitude.

evidence_endpoint: ABCG2/BCRP mRNA expression
evidence_summary: ABCG2 was directly measured in a qPCR drug-resistance panel after triclosan treatment of human MHCC97-H cells. The study reported induction of ABC/drug-resistance genes as a group; the accessible text does not provide a separate ABCG2 effect size.
audit_note: Direct human cancer-cell measurement; supports inclusion in a triclosan-responsive drug-resistance panel but avoids overclaiming a gene-specific magnitude.

evidence_endpoint: FASN enzyme activity, mRNA and protein
evidence_summary: Triclosan directly inhibited FASN activity and decreased FASN mRNA and protein in human HepG2 cells.
audit_note: Strong direct human cell evidence.

evidence_endpoint: Scd1 transcript expression
evidence_summary: Lactational triclosan exposure increased hepatic Scd1 mRNA in neonatal mice; the study also confirmed increased SCD1 protein.
audit_note: Direct nonhuman in vivo transcript and protein evidence.

evidence_endpoint: No gene-specific triclosan evidence recovered in targeted audit
evidence_summary: No independently recoverable experimental triclosan-TWIST1 evidence was identified in the targeted literature/database audit.
audit_note: Retained unchanged in the locked 24-gene panel; audit is non-reselective and does not remove genes post hoc.

model_species: Human placental cell lines; mouse adipocytes
evidence_endpoint: PPARG expression/pathway dependence
evidence_summary: Triclosan down-regulated PPARG and PPARG-regulated genes in human placental cells, with rescue by PPARG activation; newer adipocyte work also implicates PPARγ-dependent triclosan effects.
audit_note: Direct human cell pathway evidence.

evidence_endpoint: EGFR expression downstream of GPER signaling
evidence_summary: Triclosan up-regulated EGFR in 4T1 breast cancer cells through a GPER-mediated signaling pathway in a TNBC-focused study.
audit_note: Direct breast-cancer experimental evidence but nonhuman cell line.

model_species: Human placental cells; mouse 4T1 breast cancer cells
evidence_endpoint: MMP9 expression
evidence_summary: Triclosan altered MMP9 expression in human placental cells and up-regulated MMP-2/9 in 4T1 breast cancer cells via GPER signaling; direction depends on model.
audit_note: Direct experimental evidence with context-dependent direction.

evidence_endpoint: c-Jun production and JNK/c-Jun pathway modulation
evidence_summary: Triclosan modulated c-Jun production/signaling in human trophoblast cells and inhibited JNK phosphorylation/c-Jun production in human gingival fibroblasts.
audit_note: Direct human cell evidence; direction varies by context.

evidence_endpoint: c-fos mRNA / AP-1-related response
evidence_summary: Triclosan up-regulated c-fos mRNA in hormone-stimulated osteoblast-like cells and altered AP-1-related transcriptional behavior.
audit_note: Nonhuman cell evidence; c-Fos protein itself was not reduced in that study.

evidence_endpoint: No gene-specific triclosan evidence recovered in targeted audit
evidence_summary: No independently recoverable experimental triclosan-ADRB2 evidence was identified in the targeted literature/database audit.
audit_note: Retained unchanged in the locked panel; no post hoc deletion.

evidence_endpoint: No gene-specific triclosan evidence recovered in targeted audit
evidence_summary: No independently recoverable experimental triclosan-ERG evidence was identified in the targeted literature/database audit.
audit_note: Retained unchanged in the locked panel; no post hoc deletion.

evidence_endpoint: γH2AX induction / DNA double-strand-break marker
evidence_summary: A cell-based high-throughput genotoxicity screen found triclosan-induced γH2AX in a human thyroid cell line at a micromolar lowest-effect concentration.
audit_note: Direct human-cell protein-phosphorylation/genotoxicity evidence; not evidence of H2AX transcript regulation.

evidence_endpoint: No gene-specific triclosan evidence recovered in targeted audit
evidence_summary: No independently recoverable experimental triclosan-MITF evidence was identified in the targeted literature/database audit.
audit_note: Retained unchanged in the locked panel; no post hoc deletion.
